sheet.editDescription: Update the virtual key configuration and permissions.
sheet.createDescription: Create a new virtual key with specific permissions, budgets, and rate limits.
sheet.managedNotice: This virtual key is managed by an access profile. Only the name and description can be modified; providers, budgets, rate limits, and MCP access are controlled by the profile.
sheet.teamLockedNotice: Creating this virtual key under team <1>{{team}}</1>. Team assignment is pre-set; all other fields are editable.

sheet.defaultMcpClientsNotice: The following MCP servers are available to this key by default with all tools enabled on that client: <1>{{names}}</1>. Adding an explicit config for any of them below will override the all-tools default for this key.
sheet.selectMcpClientPlaceholder: Select an MCP client to add
sheet.allowAllToolsDescription: Allow all current and future tools

budgetOverrides.title: Budget Overrides
budgetOverrides.description: Add temporary capacity without changing the configured base budgets above.

reassignDialog.title: Reassign to a different team?
reassignDialog.description: This key is currently assigned to another team. Reassigning it will move budget tracking to this team; future requests through this key will count against this team’s budget, not the previous one.

calendarAligned.label: Align to calendar cycle
calendarAligned.description: Reset budgets and rate limits at the start of each period (e.g. 1st of month) instead of rolling from creation date. Quarterly budgets always align to fiscal quarter starts. Applies to durations of a day or longer.
calendarAligned.dialogDescription: Enabling calendar alignment will reset budget usage to <1>$0.00</1> and token/request rate-limit counters to <3>0</3> for this virtual key, then snap each reset date to the start of its current period (e.g. start of day, week, month, or year). The usage reset cannot be undone, but calendar alignment can be turned off later. This will take effect when you save.

sheet.singleUserNote: A virtual key can be assigned to only one user. If that user has an access profile, the key is adopted into it and becomes profile-managed.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate virtual key?
rotateDialog.description: This will replace the secret value for "{{name}}". The key ID, budgets, rate limits, provider permissions, MCP access, and assignments stay the same. The previous key value will stop working immediately.

budgetReset.titleQuarterShift: Carry usage into the new quarter?
budgetReset.descriptionWithWarning: {{message}} You can preserve usage anyway, or reset usage to 0.
budgetReset.descriptionDefault: You changed a budget amount, reset frequency, or calendar alignment. Reset current budget usage to 0, or preserve the existing usage counters.

sheet.budgetWarningOverLimit: {{scope}} {{duration}} budget has {{usage}} usage, which meets or exceeds the new {{limit}} limit.
sheet.budgetWarningQuarterShift: {{scope}} quarterly budget has {{usage}} of usage. Changing the fiscal quarter moves the reset date and carries that spend into the new quarter.
sheet.budgetWarningInherit: {{scope}} {{duration}} budget will inherit {{inherited}} from the {{fromDuration}} budget, which meets or exceeds the new {{limit}} limit.
